about_the_game:
Soak up the ambience of Ashenfall with two incredible tracks from the RuneScape: Dragonwilds soundtrack. Listen to “Into the Wild (Main Theme)” and “Wild World To Tame”, lovingly mixed and mastered by the Jagex Audio Team. Grab a cuppa and pretend you’re on Ashenfall. Without the dragon, hopefully.

Two tracks from our spellbinding soundtrack made to connect you to the anima-rich, magical landscape of RuneScape: Dragonwilds. Whether you’re woodcutting, Runecrafting or relaxing in between dragon encounters, you’ll be able to be transported to Ashenfall.
